QuestInfo.name: Pia's Present For a Friend
QuestInfo.1: I ran into that same teddy-bear-costume-wearing #p218# at the #m10001050#. Last time I saw her, I took care of some #o16#s for her. This time, she wants to make a claw as a present for a friend in #m10002000#, who's embarking on an adventure soon. The claw she wants to make requires #b15 #t4010104#s#k, #b30 #t4000050#s#k, and #b30 #t4003000#s#k... If I get her all these... will I be richly rewarded?
QuestInfo.2: #p218# asked me help her with a gift for her friend who decided to set out on an adventure. I brought back what she needed, but it seemed that wasn't enough.

0.0: Oh, you're the one who beat the #o16#s for me. You look much stronger than before. Did my scroll help you? Hehe... Anyway, good. Since you look strong, I would like to ask you a favor... Will you help me?
0.1: One of my friends in #m10002000# wants to be an adventurer. After some training, he'll start traveling soon... I would like to give him something special! So I asked #p401# in #m10003000# to make me a good claw, but he needed some weird stuff to make it.
0.2: So could you get the materials #p401# wants for me? I'd like to get them myself, but I can't move because of this stupid costume! Of course, I'll pay you if you do this for me... If you're not busy, can you please help me?

yes.0: Thanks! I need #b15 #t4010104#s#k, #b30 #t4000050#s#k, and #b30 #t4003000#s#k. Then, I'll leave it to you!

no.0: You must be very busy... If you have time later, please get back to me! My friend will set out soon...

1.0: It's the perfect time of year for an adventure!

item.0: So you haven't gotten all the materials yet? Please get #b15 #t4010104#s#k, #b30 #t4000050#s#k, and #b30 #t4003000#s#k...
